convergence: temperature termination; no additional fixed-point stopping
hardening: greedy global maximum; ties row-major; remove row and column; stop after min(n,m) matches
initialization: node agreement s2 (Algorithm1 s1 symbol corrected by argument type)
objective: paper Eq1 literal including factor 2 in edge denominator
precision_accelerated: float32 output with float64 affinity and annealing
rectangular: un-padded rectangular one-pass normalization; soft row/column sums need not both equal 1; hard assignment must be injective
s1: edge RBF exp(-mean squared feature difference); zero if either edge absent
s2: node RBF exp(-mean squared feature difference)
update: Q_ui=0.5*sum_vj(edge_agreement_uvij*M_vj)+alpha*node_agreement_ui; literal Algorithm1, not claimed Eq2 derivative
zero_edges: edge contribution zero if either graph has zero edges; retain node contribution divided by (1+alpha)
